Main fixes: bare sandhi = peace (units 1,2,3,5,6,27,28), sītā/dvandva commas in unit 7 Hindi, pratigraha gloss without the inferred hostage sense, bala = strength, yoga = connection (7.9), pratiṣṭabdha = propped (7.10), kanyā gloss girl.
